public.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
public.description: Return all letter strings represented by digits using 2=abc, 3=def, 4=ghi, 5=jkl, 6=mno, 7=pqrs, 8=tuv, 9=wxyz. Sort strings lexicographically. Input has 0 to 4 digits from 2 through 9. Empty input returns [].
hints: Extend every partial result with each letter for the next digit.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Repeated Cartesian products preserve lexicographic order. Time and space are proportional to the total output characters.
